title: Block Limiter
description: Limit specific blocks per chunk with full customization
body:
![p1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca92da8adf587b7851bf95be894cc15211361023_0.webp)Limit specific blocks per chunk with full customization
Overview History Analytics Edits

A lightweight plugin that allows you to limit specific blocks per chunk to prevent lag
FEATURES​
Per-chunk block limits
Fully configurable blocks
SQLite database
Clickable history with teleport
ActionBar + Chat messages
Custom sounds & particles

COMMANDS

/blocklimiter reload
/blocklimiter history
/blocklimiter clearhistory

PERMISION

blocklimiter.admin Access commands
blocklimiter.bypass Ignore block limits
